topIssues.title: Flashblocks support within Geth
topIssues.author: maoueh
topIssues.body:
# Rationale

We have internally added support in `op-geth` for processing flashblocks events from Websockets, reconstructing a payload then block and tracing it through Geth Live Tracing feature (incremental tracing).

Wanted to open this issue to check if there would be openness to merge our implementation directly in `op-geth` (fully or partially).

# Implementation

- Websocket clients + connection handling (reconnection) for consuming Flashblock events
- Flashblock payload state tracking + payload reconstruction
- StateDB management
- Flashblock execution + Live Tracing

## Not Present

- RPCs handling of `"pending"` state to query available Flashblock(s) execution.

topIssues.title: [INK Mainnet] Breaking change in `StorageKeys` value (`null` instead of `[]`) `op-geth` in `v1.101701.0`
topIssues.author: glokos
topIssues.body:
#### System information

Geth version: `us-docker.pkg.dev/oplabs-tools-artifacts/images/op-geth:v1.101701.0`
CL client & version: 
- curl 8.7.1 (x86_64-apple-darwin25.0)
- alloy = { version = "1.1.0", default-features = false }

OS & Version: Windows/Linux/OSX

#### Expected behaviour
storageKeys should always be serialized as an empty array ([]) when no storage slots are present, maintaining consistent JSON output and backwards compatibility.

#### Actual behaviour
storageKeys is serialized as null instead of [] when no storage slots are present, due to nil slices being produced and marshaled.

#### Steps to reproduce the behaviour
1. Use this [Gist](https://gist.github.com/glokos/054e1dad5f5e2de7b3fc39ca0f5c5737)
2. Upgrade `op-geth` to `v1.101701.0`
3. Set the `INK_RPC_ENDPOINT` variable
4. Run `request.sh` 

#### Backtrace
See [`broken_response_v1-101701-0-json`](https://gist.github.com/glokos/054e1dad5f5e2de7b3fc39ca0f5c5737#file-broken_response_v1-101701-0-json)
